# Keep fake-key offline operations distinct from real message rows

Empty Trash creates a fake key solely to attach kDeleteAllMsgs; no real message is required. Offline copy/move creates a temporary destination header and matching operation using a fake key, then records the original source identity. Current sync removes pure kMoveResult ghost rows, remembers pseudo keys for later notifications and updates pending counts. Preserve these separate purposes when changing key allocation or replay cleanup. Fake keys are not evidence of a downloaded server UID.

Scope: mailnews/imap/src.
